results.title: Capri Loans Collaborates with OpenAI to Bring Enterprise-Grade AI to Lending Operations
results.description: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], July 31: Capri Global Capital Limited, known by the brand name ‘Capri Loans’, one of the leading, retail-focused Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), today announced that it is working with OpenAI to adopt enterprise grade generative AI across key business functions. The initiative supports Capri Loans’ technology-led growth strategy. With this AI adoption, functions across customer service, operations, and knowledge workflows are expected to benefit significantly.
